app.name: rehalo
app.subtitle: Use your SmartHalo 2 again
app.localizedDescription:
rehalo is an independent, open-source iPhone app that lets you use your SmartHalo 2 bike light again, without the original app. No account and no company servers.

• Navigation: import a GPX route or search for a place, and get turn guidance on the ring, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen.
• Alarm: arms when you leave and disarms when your iPhone returns, with a five-tap code on the ring.
• Ring cards and tap shortcuts: clock, battery, speed, distance, ride time, the horn and the light.
• Front light, call alerts and optional rain alerts.
• Ring recovery: reclaim a ring that was paired to the old app.
• Demo mode: try everything without a ring.

Needs iOS 17 or later and a real iPhone.
